Q8137.reason: The act of State doctrine denotes that the assessment as to the existence of an alleged tort committed by a State belongs to the executive and not the courts.

Q5047.reason: Repeated blockage by clots requires medical staff intervention, not just informing the patient or removing the catheter without orders.
